newsitem.title: USA: ISS supports vote for Great Western merger.
newsitem.headline: ISS supports vote for Great Western merger.

text.p: Institutional Shareholder Services issued a report to its clients recommending that Great Western Financial Corp stockholders vote in favor of the proposed merger with Washington Mutual Inc at the special meeting scheduled to be held on June 13, Great Western said Friday.

"With regulatory approval, which is anticipated shortly, and an affirmative vote at the June 13 special meeting, Great Western stockholders can be in a position to receive their Washington Mutual shares and begin enjoying the economic benefits of this merger in a matter of weeks," the Great Western statement continued.
Wednesday, H.F. Ahmanson & Co dropped its hostile bid for Great Western. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
